source_row.extraction_instructions: Odoo events site. Listing walked by the extractor (page 1 /event?date=upcoming, then the /event/page/N link): one article per event with title, UTC start datetime (converted to Europe/Zurich), 'City, Country' or TBC/TBD, optional tag. Event page sidebar gives local start/end dates (a 00:00 end is exclusive) and a 'Go to website' organiser link; the page itself has no prose. edu.eular.org organiser links print 'Cost: EUR n'. Other organiser landing pages get ONE validated hop (check_url_safe + fetch_validated) for a description (meta/og or first real paragraph; text naming another year than the event is dropped) and fees (JSON-LD offers or fee table); if no fees there, ONE more hop to a registration/fees link on the same host. Cap 20 extra requests per run; otherwise a one-line template description from page fields.

registry_comment: EULAR events directory (Odoo): paginated cards -> event page dates/place; EUR fee from edu.eular.org Moodle page for EULAR-run courses

spot_check.site_says: Thursday 22 Oct 2026 to Saturday 24 Oct 2026 18:00, Vienna, Austria
Cost: EUR 1000, Berlin, 3 days from 5 June 2027 (registration opens January 2027)

concerns: Listing start datetimes are UTC and can be a day off; the extractor converts to Europe/Zurich for the shell and the event page (local dates) overrides it. Verified on the 00:00 placeholder events (listing says 7 April 2027, page says Thursday 8 April).

Events stored 00:00 to 00:00 (placeholder dates, venue TBC/TBD: Epidemiology, Imaging, Postgraduate HP, Immunology 2027 courses) get end = end date minus 1 day; their dates are indicative only and the city is left empty.
The edu.eular.org price is a list price; for 2027 courses registration has not opened ('Registration will open in January 2027') but the Cost row is already shown, so it is stored.
The flagship EULAR Annual Congress (congress.eular.org, Berlin June 2027) is NOT in eular.org/event; it would need a separate single_congress source. Not built here.
event_type: congress/conference/symposium/meeting in title -> conference (2 rows), workshop/webinar/seminar -> workshop, else course (17).

Description: eular.org pages have no prose. Real descriptions come from organiser landing pages (3 of 19: Belgrade, CECR Budapest and SARD-ILD Antalya); the other 16 use a one-line template built only from page fields (tag, title, dates, place).

Athens conflict: both Athens courses (12th International MSUS Course, Intermediate and Basic level) are listed by EULAR for 18-20 Nov 2026, but the organiser page (mitoscourse2027.eventive.gr) names 2027. EULAR's listing date is kept; the organiser description is discarded because its year differs (template used) and no fees are taken from that site. Needs a human look; the dates may be stale on EULAR's side.

Fees: 12 of 19 priced. 9 EULAR-run events from edu.eular.org (EUR list price); Belgrade from its organiser page (Registration fee 850 EUR; the 1250 'fee & accommodation' option is dropped as accommodation); SARD-ILD Antalya only shows 'External Participation (1 day) 350 EUR' after dropping accommodation rows, so it is a partial fee set. CECR Budapest and Rome/Antalya Basic/Intermediate stay empty: CECR's fee tables repeat the same labels with different prices (category lost) and the early-bird date has passed, so they are dropped as ambiguous. Organiser tiers pass a 20..10000 amount and currency sanity check, early rates already over are dropped, labels are cut to the row label.
Request budget per scrape: 2 listing pages + 19 event pages + about 9 edu.eular.org pages + at most 20 organiser hops (landing + same-host fees link both count), 1 s gap; about 31 plus up to 20.

event_format is now always set: in_person unless the title/tag/place says online/virtual/webinar (none do). Four placeholder courses (Epidemiology, Imaging, Postgraduate HP, Immunology 2027) have TBC/TBD venues, so they carry event_format in_person but no city (15 of 19 have a city); nothing invented.
